description: This file implements sparc-specific stack walking functions for the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including context frame retrieval and caller frame analysis.

classes.name: StackwalkerSPARC
classes.description: A class implementing SPARC-specific stack walking logic, including context and caller frame retrieval.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context frame based on the CPU context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the caller's stack frame based on the current stack and memory.
